Built around your two primaries first: one protected heavy squat/One-Arm Pull-up day, one assisted unilateral day, one low-cost support day, and one direct press day. The weekly long run stays easy and is kept away from the Sunday/Monday squat window.

Weeks 2-4: squat load nudges up first, strict One-Arm Pull-up keeps the same low set count and progresses through cleaner doubles/singles, assisted One-Arm Pull-up gets a little harder before adding reps, and the long run is held at the tolerated dose before backing off to 16 km in week 4. Pressing stays mostly steady so it helps without stealing recovery.

If elbows or biceps tendon get cranky, make Monday all singles and add a little more help on Tuesday before cutting the main One-Arm Pull-up exposures. If knees, shins, or Achilles get irritated on the run, hold the next run at the last pain-free distance and keep Sunday Back Squat exactly at the lower-cost dose; on the hard Friday, skip the final accessory first if overall fatigue is high.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30-45s	N/A	Quick shoulder/scap prep, then empty-bar squat and press ramps.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Back Squat: 67.5 kg x 5, 102.5 kg x 3, 132.5 kg x 1-2 before 170 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	Bodyweight	1	1-2 each side	3-4 min	8-8.5	Lead with the weaker arm. Take the second rep only if it stays clean; otherwise do 1 each side and keep the next row as singles. Week 1 standard: establish the benchmark - every single starts from a dead hang, no kip or swing, and you finish each side with at least one clean rep still in reserve. Record how each side felt; this is the standard Weeks 2-3 have to beat.	
Mon	One-Arm Pull-up	Bodyweight	2	1 each side	2-3 min	7.5-8	Clean singles per arm, full dead hang, stop before any twist or elbow flare. Week 1 standard: establish the benchmark - every single starts from a dead hang, no kip or swing, and you finish each side with at least one clean rep still in reserve. Record how each side felt; this is the standard Weeks 2-3 have to beat.	
Mon	Back Squat	170 kg top set; 160 kg back-offs	3	3	3-5 min	7.5-8	Set 1 at 170 kg, sets 2-3 at 160 kg. Up to 3 work sets; stop after 2 if the RPE ceiling is exceeded, depth slips, or bar speed clearly falls.	
Mon	Push Press	RPE-selected load	3	3	2-3 min	7	Secondary vertical-press overload only. Crisp dip and drive, no grindy lockouts.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Deep Squat Hold	Bodyweight	1	45 sec	N/A	N/A	Then do a few easy scap pulls and assisted unilateral pull ramps.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Tue	Assisted One-Arm Pull-up	Minimum assistance to stay symmetrical	2	1 per arm	2-3 min	6-6.5	Each side. Use the minimum help that keeps full ROM, no twist, and matched tempo. Recovery-first pulling microdose: technical adjacent-day exposure only, keep it at RPE 6-6.5 or easier and stop well before local fatigue.	
Tue	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	6 each leg	90-120s	6.5	Controlled lower-body support. Keep this easy enough that MMA quality stays intact.	
Tue	Ring Hamstring Curl	Bodyweight	2	8	60-90s	7	Keep hips extended and curl the heels toward you under control; shorten the lever if needed.	
Tue	Side Plank	Bodyweight	2	30-40 sec each side	30-45s	N/A	Low-cost trunk stiffness. Optional first cut if the day runs long.	
Thu	Run	N/A	1	18 km	N/A	4-5	Easy conversational long run, clearly below LT1. Separate from MMA by several hours if both happen on the same day.	
Fri	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30-45s	N/A	Low-cost recovery-contingent day. Keep everything crisp and skip the last row first if sport fatigue is high.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Fri	Chin-up	RPE-selected load	2	4	2-3 min	7-7.5	Weighted bilateral support for One-Arm Pull-up. Leave 1-2 clean reps in reserve and avoid any elbow irritation.	
Fri	Ring Hamstring Curl	Bodyweight	2	8	60-90s	6.5	Keep hips extended and curl the heels toward you under control; shorten the lever if needed.	
Fri	Neck Isometric	Bodyweight	2	20 sec each direction	20-30s	N/A	Front, back, and each side. Easy to remove if you are beat up from sparring.	
Sun	[WARMUP] Band Pull-Apart Warm-up	Light band	2	15	30-45s	N/A	Then empty-bar press and squat ramps.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Wall slide x 8; Ramp Overhead Press: 27.5 kg x 5, 42.5 kg x 3, 55 kg x 1-2 before 70 kg work sets.; Ramp Back Squat: 57.5 kg x 5, 87.5 kg x 3, 112.5 kg x 1-2 before 145 kg work sets.; Keep the warm-up specific and non-fatiguing.	
Sun	Overhead Press	70 kg	4	4	2-3 min	7.5	Direct strict work. If set 3 already reaches 8.5, do set 4 only if bar speed still looks clean.	
Sun	Back Squat	145 kg	3	5	2-4 min	6.5	Lower-cost volume/specificity exposure. Same bracing and depth standard as Monday.	
END_WEEK1_TSV
